topPRs.title: Add HPP (HousePartyProtocol) token on Base
topPRs.author: ultrafellen
topPRs.body:
## What

Adds HPP (HousePartyProtocol) on Base, bridged from Ethereum through the Base standard bridge. This PR adds two files: `data/HPP/data.json` and `data/HPP/logo.svg`.

| Chain | Address |
| - | - |
| ethereum | `0xe33fbE7584EB79e2673abe576B7AC8C0De62565c` |
| base | `0xE9BB73eD2EC7B9F0BE463ce8aF24f2cF0ae7CCE6` |
| sepolia | `0xB34e0d1fee60e078D611D4218AFB004b639C7b76` |
| base-sepolia | `0x6562A6ea4F5B1e4293eD0E6146f6Def41f963305` |

## Checks

- `name`, `symbol` and `decimals` match on-chain on all four chains (`HousePartyProtocol` / `HPP` / 18).
- Both L2 tokens return the standard bridge (`0x4200000000000000000000000000000000000010`) from `l2Bridge()` and the matching L1 HPP from `l1Token()`.
- The Ethereum HPP is on the CoinGecko token list and its source is verified on Etherscan. The Sepolia HPP is verified on Sepolia Etherscan, and both L2 tokens are verified on BaseScan.
- Deposits have been made on both routes with the standard bridge (`bridgeERC20To` on the L1StandardBridge), and a withdrawal from Base Sepolia has been proven on Sepolia.

## Note on the token factory

The L2 tokens were created by the `OptimismMintableERC20Factory` predeploy at `0x4200000000000000000000000000000000000012` on both Base and Base Sepolia, not by the factory listed for Base mainnet in the Base docs (`0xF10122D428B4bc8A9d050D06a2037259b4c4B83B`). The predeploy creates `OptimismMintableERC20` v1.4.1, which supports EIP-2612 permit, and that was a requirement for HPP. The tokens are otherwise standard: minted and burned only by the L2StandardBridge, with `remoteToken()` pointing at the L1 HPP.

## Project

- Website: https://www.hpp.io
- Ethereum token: https://etherscan.io/token/0xe33fbE7584EB79e2673abe576B7AC8C0De62565c
- Base token: https://basescan.org/token/0xE9BB73eD2EC7B9F0BE463ce8aF24f2cF0ae7CCE6

topPRs.title: Add HORMUZ on Base as a non-bridgeable token
topPRs.author: hormuz-ops
topPRs.body:
Adds HORMUZ metadata and its official logo for Base mainnet, chain ID 8453.

- Contract: `0xf912a4A0c374a33f192d0657719cE107194573F1`
- On-chain name and symbol: HORMUZ; decimals: 18.
- `tokens` contains only the real Base deployment. `nobridge: true` excludes the token from the Optimism Bridge app; no L1 token mapping or bridge support is claimed.
- The contribution contains only `data/HORMUZ/data.json` and `data/HORMUZ/logo.svg`.

The SVG is the official 1024 by 1024 raster-backed SVG containing an embedded PNG. It preserves the approved project mark and is not a vector redraw. Please confirm this logo representation is acceptable during review.

Public evidence: [website](https://hormuz.meme/), [BaseScan verified contract source](https://basescan.org/address/0xf912a4A0c374a33f192d0657719cE107194573F1#code), [Blockscout token record](https://base.blockscout.com/token/0xf912a4A0c374a33f192d0657719cE107194573F1), and [official X account](https://x.com/hormuzians).

Validation completed September 5, 2026 against upstream commit `727032d2470c70b49b5ef72761020793208cd7cf`, using the pinned dependencies and Node 22.14.0:

```sh
pnpm validate --datadir ./data --tokens HORMUZ
```

The upstream validator exited 0 with no validation errors or validation warnings. This checked the metadata schema, live Base token existence, name, symbol, decimals and the generated token-list schema. It does not establish maintainer approval or external wallet inclusion.
